decision: What followed a thing the author said is a lens, kept here beside the conversation's own: what-followed. Looked through from a turn of his - or from anywhere else, from the latest - it says his words and, from that moment until he spoke again, what was done in each place, which signs were seen or came to something, what was learned looking back, what else was entered or changed, what was released, and the ideas the work was made standing on. It is read off the records of work by their moments; nothing is written for it. What the agent says at the end of a turn is what this lens shows, and its judgment beside it.
why: The author said it on 2026-11-15: after an update the agent had begun again to draw its overviews by hand, as text in a chat - a dead surface, where a projection is neither as intelligible nor as reasonable as one made in the ecosystem, from the ecosystem, and worked with there. Every such overview was an account from memory of the same things: what was done, decided, seen, learned, released. All of it is already in the records of work, each with its moment, and a turn has its moment too. So what followed is a look, not a text: the same every time, true to what was recorded, and each line a thing one can step to.
rejected: An overview written at the end of each turn and entered as a row (typed to keep a state true, and never quite what was done); the agent's turn taken for it (its words are taken in from the transcripts as they are - what followed is not what the agent says followed); joining by where a record of work was made rather than by its moment (a record stands on what the driver last looked at, not on what the author last said).
